target_customer: Marketing teams, agencies, film and video teams, creators, and hardware companies doing physical design
problem: Creative production and physical design need many separate tools. Palette offers generative models and a studio for marketing, film and parts, robots and optics design.
business_model: Usage-based credits for individuals at $0.01 per credit, custom plans for teams and enterprise, plus an API
product_category: Generative media and physical design models

founders.name: Josephine Lee
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Scale AI, Datadog and Amazon across the two founders without saying who worked where; they met at an art program.

founders.name: Serena Pei
founders.background_notes: Multimodal research and computer vision experience per YC page.

competitors.name: Runway
competitors.what: Generative video platform for campaign footage

competitors.name: Higgsfield
competitors.what: AI creative suite with marketing content tools

competitors.name: Luma
competitors.what: Physics-first video generation for product and campaign work

technical_complexity.rationale: Training and serving multimodal generative models for video and physical design is research heavy and compute intensive for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Model quality could differentiate, but funded video model labs compete and workflow tools are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well resourced players already shipped the same wedge in 2026. No action against Palette found.

market_need_then: AI video generation had many 2026 vendors and buyers comparing tools, showing demand; Palette's own demand evidence is not published.

branding.domain_note: Uses palettelabs.com since palette.com style names were taken; Palette is shared by several unrelated companies.

identity.visual_style: Studio product with sub tools named Flow, Cut, Trace and Brush

branding.brand_signature: Studio tool names Flow, Cut, Trace and Brush

brand_strength.rationale: The name is shared with a Copenhagen startup that raised EUR 3M in 2026-08 and other products, which dilutes search; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Palette is a Summer 2026 company with two MIT founders and no disclosed funding or exit reports. It competes against heavily funded generative video leaders, and its name collides with other Palette companies. Its outcome is open and no factors are assigned.
notes: Dealroom shows a $125K seed and OpenAI backing; single aggregator that blends in another Palette, so unverified and not recorded. The EUR 3M pre-seed in 2026-08 belongs to a different Copenhagen company (palette.team) and is excluded. Company site names no founders; names come from the YC page.
